cohort: 288 pregnant women with heart disease at a tertiary care hospital in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India from February 2016 to January 2021.
finding: NYHA stage III-IV was associated with significantly higher maternal morbidity and caesarean delivery rates, but not with differences in birth weight, gestational age at delivery, or perinatal morbidity compared to NYHA stage I-II.
mod_finding: The NYHA stage III-IV group had considerably greater caesarean delivery rates.
